heroLine: Describe the job in plain words. I build the agent, test it with you and improve it.
placeholderNew: Describe the job, or pick a start below
readySuggest: Look at my agents, their automations and their recent sessions. Suggest the changes that would help most: clearer instructions, a missing tool or connection, a skill for a task they repeat, or a step that people often correct. List them from most to least useful, and ask me before you change anything.
readyCheck: Check my agents and automations for problems. Look at the last 7 days: failed sessions, runs that stopped early, automations that did not start, and connections that are missing or expired. For each problem, tell me what broke, why, and how to fix it. Fix it after I approve.
readyOptimize: Optimize {{agent}}. Write 3 test requests from its recent sessions, run them and check the answers. Then run the same requests on a cheaper or faster model and tell me if the answers stay as good. Show me the cost and the answers side by side before you change the model.

ideaTemplateLine: See the templates and what each one does.
ideaTemplatePrompt: Show me templates I can start from and explain each one.
ideaQuotesLine: Reads a request or plans and writes a priced quote.
ideaQuotesPrompt: Build an agent that reads a customer request or plans and writes a priced quote in our own format.
ideaCustomerQuestionsLine: On the website and in WhatsApp, from your documents.
ideaCustomerQuestionsPrompt: Build an agent that answers customer questions on our website and in WhatsApp from our documents, and names the source of each answer.
ideaLeadRepliesLine: Replies in minutes, qualifies and books a call.
ideaLeadRepliesPrompt: Build an agent that replies to each new lead within minutes, asks a few qualifying questions and books a call.
ideaInvoicesFormsLine: Reads them from email, checks them, enters them.
ideaInvoicesFormsPrompt: Build an agent that reads incoming invoices and forms from email, checks them and enters them into our system.
ideaSocialPostsLine: Plans and writes posts from your blog and news.
ideaSocialPostsPrompt: Build an agent that plans and writes social posts in our brand voice from our blog posts and news.
ideaClientReportLine: Traffic and ad results in a short report per client.
ideaClientReportPrompt: Build an agent that pulls each client's site traffic and ad results and writes a short weekly report for the client.
ideaProposalsLine: Drafts a proposal from a brief and your past ones.
ideaProposalsPrompt: Build an agent that drafts proposals and statements of work from a client brief and our past proposals.
ideaSupportRepliesLine: Sorts the inbox and drafts replies for approval.
ideaSupportRepliesPrompt: Build an agent that sorts our support emails and drafts replies from our help docs for a person to approve.
ideaProspectListLine: Finds and scores businesses that fit.
ideaProspectListPrompt: Build an agent that finds businesses that match our ideal client, scores them and gives me a lead list.
ideaFollowUpLine: A short personal message to old leads and quotes.
ideaFollowUpPrompt: Build an agent that follows up on open quotes and old leads with a short personal message.
